subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Must `yieldToolResult` prevent later tools in the same model-generated batch from starting, or may it hand off only after already-launched siblings finish?
rationale: The helper name, documentation, and approval/form use cases imply an atomic clean handoff, but result-level control arrives too late to determine scheduling; the permanent public Plugin SDK semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Require an atomic yield barrier
options.body: Require and enforce sequential scheduling for tools that may yield, stopping later same-batch calls after the yielding result.

options.title: Define post-batch handoff
options.body: Keep parallel execution and explicitly document that siblings may start or finish before the runtime hands off the turn.

recommendation.title: Require an atomic yield barrier
recommendation.body: Require and enforce sequential scheduling for tools that may yield, stopping later same-batch calls after the yielding result.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor explicitly requested this public Plugin SDK decision from @steipete, who is also connected to recent OpenClaw runtime integration work.
